cv.name: Rebecca Kingston
cv.headline: CMO / GM Marketing – Retail, Consumer & Membership Brands
cv.summary: Marketing executive with 18 years across retail, consumer goods and member-based organisations in Australia. Has led marketing teams of up to 45 and budgets above A$20M, with a focus on brand, loyalty and customer data.

experience.title: GM – Mktg & Member Exp. (Exec Leadership Team)
bullets: Lead marketing, member experience and insights; team of 45 and budget of A$22M
Repositioned the brand for younger members; under-35 membership up 19% in two years
Delivered a new loyalty program with 14 retail and travel partners
Member of the executive leadership team reporting to the CEO

experience.title: Head of Brand & Comms (Dir. grade)
bullets: Owned brand strategy, media and creative agencies for 140 stores

experience.title: Sr. Brand Mgr / Mktg Mgr – Snacks
bullets: Managed a A$90M snacks portfolio and two product relaunches

experience.title: Asst. Brand Manager
bullets: Supported launches in personal care and the annual brand plan

certifications: Graduate, Australian Institute of Company Directors (GAICD)
